scope: All 121 relevant image unit parameter variants and BDD examples, preserving existing evidence and unsupported obligations. New admission/insertion does not implement the neutral public Image/Picture model.

languageMappings.bytes: Explicit Uint8Array and declared MIME; no implicit string coercion or host lookup.
languageMappings.dimensions: Numbers in pixels and normalized per-axis DPI; integer EMU geometry in insertion. Unknown JPEG dimensions require explicit width and height with default or explicit stretch.
languageMappings.decode: Container/header checks only; no decoded pixel validation, native runtime or decompression.
languageMappings.model: Inherited/public underscore-prefixed members remain inventoried in image-inventory-api-map.json, still planned; operation APIs do not replace them.
languageMappings.physicalRatio: Insertion uses physical aspect (pixelWidth / dpiX) / (pixelHeight / dpiY), converting inches at 914400 EMU per inch. Existing metadata cases independently assert non-square DPI (PNG 96/48, JPEG 102/51). No dedicated end-to-end unequal-DPI insertion test is claimed.
languageMappings.explicitFit: Supplying both width and height defaults to stretch; explicit contain, cover and stretch remain supported. A supplied fit requires both dimensions. This bounded operation behavior does not implement the neutral public ImagePart model.
